page.description: When the workshop is open, the days it is closed, and who is away. The work board, scheduling, the calendar, online booking and the customer portal all follow it.

switch.title: Closed days and leave
switch.label: Use closed days, public holidays and leave
switch.hint: When this is off, nothing on this page except the opening hours changes the work board, scheduling, the calendar or online booking. Everything you entered is kept.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: When the workshop is open on each day of the week. Online booking and the next free slot only offer these hours, and the work board shades the rest.
hours.copyMonday: Copy Monday to the other weekdays
hours.invalid: {day}: the closing time must be after the opening time
hours.allClosed: Every day is closed, so nothing can be booked online.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.description: Pick your country, and your state or region where holidays differ, to close on its public holidays. The dates come from Nager.Date and are updated every day.
holidays.regionsHint: A holiday kept only in some regions counts when one of yours is ticked. Nationwide holidays always count.
holidays.countriesFailed: Could not load the list of countries ({error}). Try again later.
holidays.notPublic: Not a public holiday, so open unless you close it
holidays.fetchError: Could not update the holidays: {error}. The days already listed still count.
holidays.none: Nager.Date has no public holidays for this country.
holidays.pickCountry: Pick a country to list its public holidays.

feeds.title: Holiday calendars
feeds.description: Add any holiday calendar as an .ics link or file: a government feed, Google's holiday calendars, your own. A link is read again every day.
feeds.linkPlaceholder: https:// or webcal:// link to an .ics calendar
feeds.tooLarge: The file is too large. Holiday calendars are much smaller than 900 KB.
feeds.removeDescription: Its days stop closing the workshop. You can add it again later.
feeds.days: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in {first} and {second}
feeds.choose: Each day closes the workshop unless you switch it off. Days a Google calendar marks as observances, such as Valentine's Day, start switched off.

closures.title: Closed days
closures.description: Days the workshop is closed for its own reasons: a shutdown week, a staff day, closing early before a holiday.
closures.name: Name
closures.yearlyHint: Closed on the same dates every year.
closures.deleteDescription: The workshop opens as usual on these days again.

stretch.startTimeHint: On the first day. Leave empty for the whole day.
stretch.endTimeHint: On the last day. Leave empty for the rest of the day.
stretch.endBeforeStart: The last day is before the first
stretch.timesCross: The end time is before the start time
stretch.tooLong: One entry can cover at most a year

timeOff.title: Leave and out of office
timeOff.description: Set a technician on leave or out of office: holidays, sick days, courses. While away they are not offered for bookings, and the work board and scheduling show it.
timeOff.add: Set on leave or out of office
timeOff.edit: Edit leave or out of office
timeOff.notePlaceholder: Optional, such as the name of the course
timeOff.empty: Nobody is on leave or out of office in the coming weeks.
timeOff.deleteDescription: {name} counts as available on these days again.
timeOff.noTechnicians: Add technicians on the work board first.
timeOff.disabled: Leave is switched off for this workshop. Turn it on under Settings, Opening hours and holidays.
timeOff.setForTechnician: Set {name} on leave or out of office

range.fromUntil: {dates}, from {start} on the first day until {end} on the last

board.closedWeekday: The workshop is closed on this day
board.dropClosed: The workshop is closed then ({name}). The job is scheduled anyway.
board.dropClosedWeekday: The workshop is normally closed then. The job is scheduled anyway.
board.dropAway: {name} is away then ({reason}). The job is scheduled anyway.

schedule.closedWeekday: The workshop is normally closed on this day.
schedule.bookedAnyway: You can still keep this time if the work is agreed.
schedule.awayHeadingTeam: Someone on this job is away then

portal.closedDay: The workshop is closed on that day ({name}). Please pick another day.
portal.closedWeekday: The workshop is closed on that day. Please pick another day.
